# @arki/ui
> React components for ARKI apps: Base UI primitives on Tailwind v4 semantic tokens. One subpath per component, no root import.
## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- math-input/* (3 paths): `@arki/ui/math-input`, `@arki/ui/math-input/complex-input`, `@arki/ui/math-input/index`.
- hooks/* (15 paths): `@arki/ui/hooks/async-memo`, `@arki/ui/hooks/copy-to-clipboard`, `@arki/ui/hooks/debounce`, `@arki/ui/hooks/hotkeys`, `@arki/ui/hooks/is-client`, `@arki/ui/hooks/local-storage`, `@arki/ui/hooks/long-press`, `@arki/ui/hooks/media-query`, `@arki/ui/hooks/pagination`, `@arki/ui/hooks/timeout`, `@arki/ui/hooks/toggle`, `@arki/ui/hooks/touch`, `@arki/ui/hooks/use-swipe-gesture`, `@arki/ui/hooks/use-touch-feedback`, `@arki/ui/hooks/use-viewport`.
- one path each: `@arki/ui/utils`, `@arki/ui/cn`, `@arki/ui/design-system`, `@arki/ui/accordion`, `@arki/ui/alert`, `@arki/ui/alert-dialog`, `@arki/ui/aspect-ratio`, `@arki/ui/avatar`, `@arki/ui/badge`, `@arki/ui/breadcrumb`, `@arki/ui/button`, `@arki/ui/calendar`, `@arki/ui/callout`, `@arki/ui/card`, `@arki/ui/carousel`, `@arki/ui/chart`, `@arki/ui/checkbox`, `@arki/ui/collapsible`, `@arki/ui/color-picker`, `@arki/ui/command`, `@arki/ui/context-menu`, `@arki/ui/control-group`, `@arki/ui/date-picker`, `@arki/ui/dialog`, `@arki/ui/drawer`, `@arki/ui/dropdown-menu`, `@arki/ui/form`, `@arki/ui/glass-card`, `@arki/ui/hover-card`, `@arki/ui/input`, `@arki/ui/input-base`, `@arki/ui/input-otp`, `@arki/ui/katex`, `@arki/ui/label`, `@arki/ui/complex-input`, `@arki/ui/menubar`, `@arki/ui/navigation-menu`, `@arki/ui/pagination`, `@arki/ui/panel`, `@arki/ui/popover`, `@arki/ui/progress`, `@arki/ui/radio-group`, `@arki/ui/resizable`, `@arki/ui/scroll-area`, `@arki/ui/scroll-to-top`, `@arki/ui/select`, `@arki/ui/separator`, `@arki/ui/sheet`, `@arki/ui/sidebar`, `@arki/ui/skeleton`, `@arki/ui/slider`, `@arki/ui/sonner`, `@arki/ui/spinners`, `@arki/ui/surface`, `@arki/ui/switch`, `@arki/ui/table`, `@arki/ui/tabs`, `@arki/ui/textarea`, `@arki/ui/textarea-with-autosize`, `@arki/ui/timeline`, `@arki/ui/toggle`, `@arki/ui/toggle-group`, `@arki/ui/tool-panels`, `@arki/ui/toolbar`, `@arki/ui/tooltip`, `@arki/ui/styles/animations.css`, `@arki/ui/as-child`, `@arki/ui/slot`.
